safety_gates.station_stopped_gate: HARD_GATE (ports 8000, 8080, 18000, 18001, 18002 must be FREE; -Force cannot bypass)
safety_gates.version_discovery: Independently inspects npm (@openhands/agent-canvas) and PyPI (openhands-agent-server, openhands-automation)
safety_gates.backend_pypi_policy: PINNED (PyPI backend updates do NOT automatically alter production pins; Canvas defaults.json pins take precedence)
safety_gates.localization_gate: STRICT_GATE_KEEP (audit-localization.py must verify 0 missing keys in ru.json; aborts & rolls back if violated)
safety_gates.voice_ui_gate: STRICT_ANCHOR_VERIFY (build/index.html must contain verified voice-bridge.css and voice-bridge.js tags)
safety_gates.backup_strategy: Full folder copy to K:\Project\Archive\backups\OpenHands\<timestamp>-v<ver>\ and local backup folder
safety_gates.rollback_boundary: Atomic rollback of entire package, defaults.json pins, and patch state; default state: STATION STOPPED
